objective: Implement the in-memory Cache module (get/set with 60s TTL) matching contract C2 with unit tests covering the hit, miss, and expiry paths
non_goals: Do not touch app/api/** (T01 owns the endpoint)
implementation_constraints: get(key) returns None on both miss and expiry — callers cannot distinguish, per C2

deliverables.what: unit tests for hit, miss, and expiry

acceptance_tests.description: set then get returns the stored value (cache hit)
acceptance_tests.evidence: pytest tests/test_cache.py::test_hit asserts the value is returned

acceptance_tests.description: get for an unset key returns None (cache miss)
acceptance_tests.evidence: pytest tests/test_cache.py::test_miss asserts get('unset') is None

failure_cases.expected_behavior: a test asserts ValueError is raised — inputs are validated, not clamped silently

handoff.notes: record the get/set signatures in verified_facts
